ns2:section.sectionText: THIS CRN IS A POLICY & PLANNING CONCENTRATION for juniors in Urban Studies and Planning only. Students must select the section for their concentration: Sustainability, Daniel Schneider; Social Justice, Andrew Greenlee; Policy & Planning, Bumsoo Lee and Lindsay Braun; or Global Cities, Faranak Miraftab. Students with two concentrations only register for one section. Students will continue to see the BAUSP Program Director for general advising, including any registration issues with UP 301.
